_meta.description: Bathroom tile products. Price is per square foot.

hits.name: Bone White Subway Tile 3×6"
hits.description: Handcrafted matte white subway tile 3×6". Each tile has slight variation — very Scandi.
hits.imagePrompt: Bone white matte subway tile, 3x6 inches, rectangular glazed ceramic with subtle surface texture and clean grout lines.

hits.name: Light Grey Large Format 12×24"
hits.description: Light grey porcelain tile 12×24". Minimal grout lines create a clean, expansive floor.
hits.imagePrompt: Light grey porcelain floor tile, matte finish, rectangular 12x24 inch format, clean edges, uniform surface texture

hits.name: White Hexagon Mosaic
hits.description: Matte white 1" hexagon mosaic. Timeless floor tile, scaled for small bathrooms.
hits.imagePrompt: White ceramic hexagon tiles arranged in interlocking mosaic pattern, glossy finish, geometric floor installation view.

hits.name: Zellige Gloss White 4×4"
hits.description: Handmade Moroccan zellige tile in white gloss. Slight ripple adds texture without pattern.
hits.imagePrompt: Glossy white zellige tile, 4x4 inches, hand-pressed clay with irregular surface texture and subtle dimensional bumps.

hits.name: Seafoam Gloss Subway 3×6"
hits.description: Gloss subway tile in soft seafoam. A classic coastal colour — works with white vanities and brass.
hits.imagePrompt: Seafoam glossy subway tile, 3x6 inches, smooth polished surface, bright aqua-green ceramic finish, rectangular beveled edges, clean modernist aesthetic.

hits.name: Pebble Shore Mosaic
hits.description: Natural river pebble mosaic in grey and white. Outdoor shower feel brought indoors.
hits.imagePrompt: Tumbled natural stone mosaic floor tile with irregular pebble pattern in grey and white tones.

hits.name: Sandy Beige Limestone 12×12"
hits.description: Honed limestone tile in sandy beige. Warm and natural — classic Beach House floor.
hits.imagePrompt: Honed beige limestone floor tile, 12x12 inch square, matte finish, natural stone texture with subtle veining.

hits.name: Driftwood Plank Tile 4×24"
hits.description: Wood-look porcelain plank in whitewashed oak finish. Water-resistant warmth.
hits.imagePrompt: Whitewashed porcelain plank tile, four-by-twenty-four inch format, wood grain texture, light cream surface with subtle gray undertones.
